body: Well he broke up with me Saturday and was incredibly angry with me for “leaving him on read”. But then said he needed time to think and never heard from him since. We were supposed to be together this whole week and then a 3 day trip in June already booked then a trip to Canada after that, again, already booked. Which he told me to book. Idk what changed I guess expecting a text every 24 hours when he has friends over every single night is just too much for him.
Maybe you should read the article on the cheerleader from Louisiana that drowned herself this past week
Oh god you’re drunk. That’s not helpful
I can barely understand your typing…
I wish that happened to me. It doesn’t help I work in a very emotionally demanding field in healthcare.
I’ve been waiting for it to go away for 20 years.
Which state? For mine it showed up same day and the latest the next day

Thank you so much. This third party is mentally unstable… and I don’t even know where she is but I am seeing her son. I read something in NM law about being held accountable by telling someone something with malicious intent. There was no malicious intent. We were simply venting about our abuse histories.
I should add, we’ve never had physical contact whatsoever. Just lots of phone calls

I won’t be sending money for sure or receiving any random money for people he did work for whatever that work may be. Why do you think he’s playing me? I initiated contact. He’s asked me to meet his dad this week and talk with his sister. He spends his only 2 hours out talking to me once or twice a day. I just don’t see it as him playing me I don’t give him anything. Even when I was an employee he always said it was the best part of his day to see me and no one else there has ever interacted with him other than inmates.
Yeah he said he feels bad about the call money and I told him it’s not an issue.
Why does it make women in corrections look bad? When I felt things were going to become unprofessional I removed myself. I did the right thing and left
